_comment: Seated ankle pump (dorsi/plantar flexion). Camera placed to patient's side at foot level.

metrics.name: ankle_angle
metrics._comment: Angle at the ankle. Neutral ~90 deg. Dorsiflexion (toes up) decreases angle. Plantarflexion (toes down) increases angle.

metrics.name: ankle_angle_delta
metrics._comment: Tracks foot-index vertical movement relative to ankle — positive = toes rising (dorsiflexion).

phases.name: dorsiflexed
phases._comment: Toes pulled toward shin — dorsiflexion target.

phases.name: plantarflexed
phases._comment: Toes pushed away from shin — plantarflexion target.

_comment_rep_cycle: One full pump = dorsiflexion + plantarflexion + return to neutral.

form_rules.cue: Slow it down — move through the full range steadily.

form_rules._comment: Sentinel: low_confidence is fired by the engine when frame confidence drops below min_pose_confidence, not by this rule. This entry documents the code is active for this exercise.
form_rules.cue: Keep your leg in the camera frame for accurate tracking.
